name: Seraiah
bio: Seraiah son of Neriah, a quartermaster and Baruch's brother, accompanied King Zedekiah to Babylon. Jeremiah gave him a scroll recording all his judgments against Babylon, instructing him to read it aloud there, tie a stone to it, and sink it in the Euphrates as a sign that Babylon would sink and never rise again (Jeremiah 51:59-64).
